executionPolicy: A single tester model runs RUNNABLE_NOW in runnableSequence order against one existing WSL profile and one Electron generation.
classificationPolicy: Only intrinsically impossible Apple/mobile, non-Docker scope, direct Cursor identity/billing/usage/access flows removed by Codex Local, app-updater paths disabled by the fixed WSL launcher, unavailable real hardware success paths, absent wallpaper helpers, unpackaged single-instance behavior, unsupported host-only restart continuity, internal-only, not-applicable, and forbidden current-profile first-run behaviors are excluded. Agent, gated, external, fault, repository, destructive, computer-update, and supported restart/recovery behaviors remain mandatory attempts.
limitation: A mandatory case may end BLOCKED_EXTERNAL or UNREACHABLE_CURRENT_BUILD only after evidence-backed attempts. It may never be silently skipped or pre-excluded merely because the current build is expected to fail.
